items.question: What depth measure destroys other castes in this graded descent?
premises: Other castes are destroyed by two.
Or they are destroyed by three angulas.
The measure follows the graded descent.
items.inference: The prescribed destruction uses either two or three angulas depending on grade.
uncertainties: The exact referent of dvābhyāṃ is unclear.
The full bhūmi context is not supplied.
items.plain_english: The destruction of other castes is by two or by three angulas.
